body.x: Audi displayed a variety of tech and ideas on piloted driving, infotainment, connectivity, laser beam, operation and display at the CES, the world’s most important electronics trade show.
Audi uses the CES as a stage for its innovations, including vehicle models.

In its booth, Audi displayed the A3 Sedan, the A3 Cabriolet, the new Audi S8 and the Audi Sport quattro laserlight concept, which is making its world premiere in Las Vegas. With a range of nearly 500 meters (1,640.42 ft), the laser high beam of the Sport quattro concept shines twice as far and three times brighter than an LED high beam.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
